def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The empty/background cells separating two equal-colored marks in a row
    # become color 2.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c] != row[c - 1]:
                # Only fill a one-cell gap; identify the background by its
                # prevalence across the grid.
                pass
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1, len(row) - 1):
            if row[c] == bg and row[c - 1] == row[c + 1] and row[c - 1] != bg:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
PY
